Which Bacardi rum is best? No matter what the situation calls, it seems Bacardi has rum for every occasion. The best Bacardi rums range from the classic journeyman rum of Bacardi Carta Blanca to the incredible depth of Bacardi Gran Reserva Limitada.

I never realised how extensive their range was. There is a Bacardi rum for everyone, from cocktails for those hot sultry nights to tasty and aromatic sippers for the rum connoisseur.

 Table Of Contents

- [Best Bacardi Rums](#best-bacardi-rums)[1. BACARDÍ CARTA BLANCA](#1-bacardí-carta-blanca)
- [2. BACARDÍ SPICED](#2-bacardí-spiced)
- [3. BACARDÍ CARTA ORO](#3-bacardí-carta-oro)
- [4. BACARDÍ CARTA NEGRA](#4-bacardí-carta-negra)
- [5. BACARDÍ AÑEJO CUATRO](#5-bacardí-añejo-cuatro)
- [6. BACARDÍ RESERVA OCHO](#6-bacardí-reserva-ocho)
- [7. BACARDÍ GRAN RESERVA DIEZ](#7-bacardí-gran-reserva-diez)
- [8. BACARDÍ GRAN RESERVA LIMITADA](#8-bacardí-gran-reserva-limitada)

- [Andrew’s Top Pick](#andrews-top-pick)[Bacardi Reserva Ocho](#bacardi-reserva-ocho)

- [Bacardi Rum Q&A](#bacardi-rum-qa)[What Is Bacardi Rum Made From?](#what-is-bacardi-rum-made-from)
- [What Does Bacardi Rum Taste Like?](#what-does-bacardi-rum-taste-like)
- [How Strong Is Bacardi Rum?](#how-strong-is-bacardi-rum)

- [Conclusion](#conclusion)
- [Further Reading](#further-reading)

From clean Bacardi Carta Blanca to the tremendous depth of Bacardi Gran Reserva Limitada, here are 8 of the best Bacardi rums to consider.

### 1. BACARDÍ CARTA BLANCA

Credit: Bacardi

#### Overview

- Distiller: Bacardi

- ABV: 37.5% (75 Proof)

- Country: Puerto Rico

- Colour: Clear

#### Review

Bacardi Carta Blanca was the original light [white rum](../best-white-rum-brands/) first made in 1862 by Don Facundo Bacardi Masso. This blend of independently aged full-bodied and drier light-bodied rums revolutionised the cocktail world as the first mixable rum.

Originally called Ron Superior de Bacardi, the blend of rums is aged in American white oak barrels. It is then passed through charcoal for a distinctively smooth taste.

#### On The Nose

A fresh bouquet of citrus, complemented with spice and pepper.

#### On The Palate

Notes of muscovado sugar and tropical fruit with a hint of sweetness but finishes off with a lingering taste of cracked pepper and smooth vanilla and zesty citrus essence.

#### Best Severed

Bacardi Carta Blanca doesn’t dominate or disappear but adds an uplifting flavour to any fruity cocktail and is an [excellent base for a mojito](../best-rums-for-mojitos/).

#### Pricing & Info

You can check the latest pricing, product information, and order online.

### 2. BACARDÍ SPICED

Credit: Bacardi

#### Overview

- Distiller: Bacardi

- ABV: 35% (70 Proof)

- Country: Puerto Rico

- Colour: Clear/Amber

#### Review

Originally launched in 2011 under Bacardi Oakheart, Bacardi Spiced is a [spiced rum](../top-10-best-spiced-rum-brands/) that has made an excitingly new debut in 2019 and rejoins the Bacardi rum portfolio.

Made with aged and un-aged rums blended with a sneaky blend of warm vanilla, adding a pinch of nutmeg and cinnamon spices. A delightful hint of smokiness from charred American oak barrels also infuses this spirit.

Bacardi Spiced is a gluten-free blend busting with essences of spice and natural flavours. A bold yet satisfyingly smooth taste with a mix of both light and deep notes.

#### On The Nose

Notes of sweet vanilla and spicy cinnamon.

#### On The Palate
